notes.hook: 'Mike, why are you looking at your test paper upside down?'
notes.what_goes_wrong: Four recycled joke-book one-liners in a row with a generic Western character; viewers have heard every punchline, and there is no single build.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: strings of old textbook jokes with generic characters; one original situation beats four borrowed punchlines.
